text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line!!
The undisputed champion of the dirt has been decided right here, right nooow!!”
Though she missed the win, as I went to greet Inari One after her solid performance—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh...
It frustrates me, but everyone at Ohi really is something else...!
They sure ain't gonna let me take 1st place easily...!
choice_data_list: Now that's what I'm talking about.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
That makes claiming the "top" totally worth it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: At the next Tokyo Daishoten, for sure...! I'm gonna take the crown right here!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
—Heh, look at you talkin' big.
Glad to see your spirit ain't broken yet.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Come year-end, we're gonna be even stronger.
You get it, don't you, Inari?
You're the one who lit that "fire."

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: No matter how massive the inferno you've sparked, you'd better overcome it without fail! That's what it means to—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: That's what Oi spirit is all about, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
I'm lookin' forward to it.
To the festival that'll decide who's truly at the top.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...By year's end, I'll build up even more strength.
With the spirit of Oi in my heart—"

The next battle is the year-end Tokyo Daishoten.
That is where the NAR's "top dog" will be decided...!
